=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:133-162 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" step still clones gh_helpers.sh and emit_event.sh from the moving `stable` ref (`ghr_ref=stable`, line 143) on pinned consumer runs. The same pattern is in validate.yml:126, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:97, security-audit.yml:87 and review_autofix.yml:341. The helpers are sourced at implement.yml:169 and 333 in steps holding GH_PAT.
  WHY: A moved `stable` runs newer, unpinned code with GH_PAT in scope, which is the supply-chain path the PR says it closes. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) vs BLOCKER (the other three); the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:219-310 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The run-start support checkout (`continue-on-error`) has no pinned-HEAD verification before "Stage workflow memory support files for run-start". A missing checkout only warns and exits 0, and the next step sources memory helpers with GH_TOKEN=GH_PAT.
  WHY: A pinned run can execute unverified or workspace-owned scripts, and only the later job's Ensure step (~385) verifies HEAD. Severity disagreement: NIT, MAJOR and BLOCKER across reviewers; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:442-493 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate-notice checkout (`DUPLICATE_NOTICE_SCRIPT_REF`) is never HEAD-verified. The Telegram step sources tg_helpers.sh from it with TG_BOT_SECRET and GH_PAT.
  WHY: Pinned runs execute unverified support code, and the Ensure step at ~1117-1134 is skipped when SKIP_IMPLEMENT is true. Severity disagreement: NIT vs BLOCKER; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6471-6515 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The heal-report job checks out support (6493-6504) and runs workflow_failure_heal_phase_report.sh (6505) with no Ensure/Verify HEAD step. The same pattern is in clarify.yml:2321-2366 and plan.yml:3144-3188.
  WHY: The script runs unverified with GH_PAT, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and TG_BOT_SECRET, plus id-token write in implement.yml.
- tests/test_workflow_support_ref_follows_pin.py:119-147 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_pinned_support_checkout_head_is_verified` uses `assert steps, workflow`, so it needs only one Ensure/Verify step per workflow rather than one per support-checkout job.
  WHY: The unverified paths (orchestrate run-start, implement duplicate-notice, heal-report jobs) pass the test untested. Severity disagreement: NIT vs MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:190-204 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `resolver_stage_fail_closed` takes the `resolver_ci_triage_routing_on` branch first (the default) and logs `ci_triage_routing=on` without `pinned_ref=`. The same code is in clarify.yml:146-158, implement.yml:575-587, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:256-268 and validate.yml:202-214.
  WHY: The documented `reason=<token> pinned_ref=<sha>` line is not emitted on the default path, and the test covers only routing=false. Severity disagreement: NIT vs MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:45 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The fallback checkout is now gated on `env.SCRIPT_REF == 'stable'`, so a pinned run whose primary checkout fails transiently has no support scripts (also check_failure_triage.yml:326, clarify.yml:389, implement.yml:1102, orchestrate.yml:349, orchestrate_poll.yml:132).
  WHY: A transient checkout failure halts the pinned run instead of retrying.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py:349-368 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_ai_review_template_pins_only_the_sweep_support_checkout` now asserts three pinned support checkouts, so its name is inaccurate.
  WHY: The name misleads future maintainers about the test's scope.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:146-148 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A stale comment about using the released action ref as the rollout boundary sits above a `uses:` that is now a commit pin (same at orchestrate_poll.yml:423-425).
  WHY: It misleads maintainers away from bumping the pin.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: A pinned run takes its support checkout and support code from that SHA, and no support code comes from `stable` or `main`.
  expected_change_site: "Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper" steps in implement.yml:133-162, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:~97, validate.yml:~126, security-audit.yml:~87, review_autofix.yml:~341
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `ghr_ref=stable` remains in all of these steps and no diff hunk touches them. The PR defers only validate.yml's `setup-runtime@stable`.
- requirement: Verifies the checkout HEAD equals the pin before staging anything, in the existing Ensure steps and the new Verify step.
  expected_change_site: orchestrate.yml run-start path (219-296), implement.yml duplicate-notice path (442-493), and the heal-report jobs in implement.yml, clarify.yml and plan.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: None of these paths has an Ensure/Verify step. The contract test requires only one such step per workflow, so they pass untested.
- requirement: Contract tests ensure the Ensure/Verify steps are executed against a real git checkout, with per-job coverage implied by "every nested support checkout".
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_support_ref_follows_pin.py `test_pinned_support_checkout_head_is_verified` (119-147)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The test asserts `assert steps, workflow` (at least one per workflow) instead of one per support-checkout job.
- requirement: The integration-ref resolver follows the pin and fails closed, emitting INTEGRATION_REF_RESOLVE outcome=resolver_unavailable reason=<token> pinned_ref=<sha>.
  expected_change_site: resolver_stage_fail_closed in plan.yml, clarify.yml, implement.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, validate.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: With CI_TRIAGE_PR_BRANCH_ROUTING_ENABLED true (the default), the first branch logs ci_triage_routing=on without pinned_ref.
- requirement: Every `Check out trusted provider-outage support` checkout is pinned via `_PINNED_SUPPORT_CHECKOUT_PATHS`, and no support checkout in a rendered wrapper is left on `stable`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py `test_ai_review_template_pins_only_the_sweep_support_checkout` (line 348)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/workflow_wrapper_refs.py handles `.provider-outage-support` (line 28), so the behavior is correct. The test name still says "the sweep", which is a naming nit only.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:143-144 (same pattern in validate.yml:126, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:97, security-audit.yml:87) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bootstrap step clones gh_helpers.sh and emit_event.sh from the moving `stable` branch on a pinned consumer run.
  WHY: The next step (implement.yml:169) sources the helper with GH_TOKEN=GH_PAT. The existing test greps only `uses:` lines, and the agents.d fragment and changelog overstate what is delivered.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:219-259, 298-310 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The run-start checkout has no pinned-HEAD verification before staging. If the checkout fails, staging warns, exits 0, and the next step sources workspace scripts with GH_PAT.
  WHY: The success path is exact for a 40-hex SHA, and the fallback existed before this PR, so this is not a regression.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:442-452, 476-493 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `DUPLICATE_NOTICE_SCRIPT_REF` is never verified against HEAD.
  WHY: A successful SHA checkout is exact, so there is no realistic exploit. The only gap is the missing verification step.
- plan.yml, clarify.yml, implement.yml, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml, validate.yml (`resolver_stage_fail_closed`, e.g. plan.yml ~190-198) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `pinned_ref=<sha>` log is only reached when routing is off, and routing defaults to on.
  WHY: Behavior is still fail-closed, so this is a log-contract mismatch only.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py (`test_ai_review_template_pins_only_the_sweep_support_checkout`) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test name no longer matches its behavior, since it now asserts all three support checkouts are pinned.
  WHY: Maintainability only.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: A pinned run takes its support checkout from the SHA, and support code is no longer taken from stable/main.
  Expected change site: bootstrap steps in implement.yml:133-162, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:~97, validate.yml:~126, security-audit.yml:~87
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk touches these steps, and `ghr_ref=stable` remains. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Verifies the checkout HEAD equals the pin before staging anything, in the existing Ensure steps and a new Verify step.
  Expected change site: orchestrate.yml run-start (219-296) and implement.yml duplicate-notice (442-493)
  Evidence of absence: Neither path has an Ensure or Verify step, and the test asserts only `assert steps, workflow`. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: derive `ghr_ref` from `toJSON(job).workflow_ref` with the 40-hex regex, about 8 lines per workflow. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
